title: Look at your own feet
literal_meaning: Woman with swollen legs, look at your own feet.
explanation: A sharp retort turns scrutiny back on the critic: examine your own shortcomings before mocking someone else’s.
meaning_odia: ଅନ୍ୟର ତ୍ରୁଟି ଦେଖାଇବା ପୂର୍ବରୁ ନିଜ ପଟକୁ ବି ଦେଖିବାର କଥା ଏଥିରେ ଅଛି। ନିଜର ଅସୁବିଧାକୁ ଭୁଲି ଅନ୍ୟକୁ ଟିପ୍ପଣୀ କଲେ ସେହି ଅମେଳ ପଦାରେ ପଡ଼େ। ଶରୀରକୁ ନେଇ ଥିବା କଟୁ ଉପମା ଅପେକ୍ଷା ଆତ୍ମସମୀକ୍ଷାର ଭାବଟି ଉପଯୋଗୀ।
usage_example: Someone criticises a neighbour’s untidy records while their own paperwork is in disarray. (New editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
cultural_context: The body-directed insult is part of the historical-style wording, not a recommended way to address illness or disability. Meaning is an editorial reading.

graphic.caption: Imagined neighbours: look at your own records before criticising.

odia_summary: ଅନ୍ୟର ଦୋଷ ଧରିବା ପୂର୍ବରୁ ନିଜ ଅସୁବିଧା ଓ ଦୋଷକୁ ମଧ୍ୟ ଦେଖିବା ଦରକାର।
english_summary: Before mocking another person’s shortcomings, look at your own.
